goal: A framework that works on all 90 existing stocks and every new one, that catches the errors that actually happen, and that works a red gate until it is green.

properties.title: It reaches all 90 names, and every new one
properties.test: A gate run reports 90 examined and 0 unaccounted. A ticker added to data.js with no record makes the build red.
properties.note: The gates already read the whole published book — that was more delivered than first specified. check_published_gap now computes every one of the 90 gaps from the site itself, and 58 of them exceed ten per cent.

properties.title: It catches the errors that actually happen
properties.test: Every confirmed gap is closed by a gate or listed with a reason, and every closed gap has a negative control that re-plants the real defect.
properties.note: All three named errors are gated and proved by planting them. Of the census's 40 verified gaps, ten families are closed or partly closed and five remain. The sharpest finds today were reader-facing: 93 pages naming a retired construction, two studies publishing a central beneath their own disclosed floor, and four anchoring profit behind their own balance sheet.

properties.title: A red gate is worked until it is green
properties.test: Run against studies with defects deliberately planted, it fixes the fixable, escalates the rest, and leaves every gate, control and ratchet byte-identical.
properties.note: Built, including the fixing half — and it now says honestly how much it can ever fix. Latest sweep: 68 green, 0 red, 0 broken, and 136 known items of debt no gate was reporting because every one is allowed. Triaged by what each item NEEDS: 3.2% transcription (the only share a loop may close), 71% a figure out of a filing, 12% a judgement, 14% the principal's decision.

queue.item: Correct the Phase 1 date — criterion 3 named the wrong score
queue.detail: The 2027 date was the maturity of the gap-closure clauses, reported as the whole of Phase 1. Four of six clauses do not wait on a clock.

queue.item: Prove the gates bind on new work
queue.detail: check_new_study_gauntlet: 38 of 38 gates refuse a new study, every exclusion carrying a stated reason.

queue.item: Locate and price the named errors
queue.detail: Stale asset base and the Ke level, both confirmed uncovered, both priced on committed numbers.

BUILT. engine/asset_base.py + check_asset_base.py + a 15-case negative control, and it is in the new-study gauntlet. Scope is DERIVED from the lens registry — 7 asset-based classes, 11 studies in scope — never a typed list. The test is an ORDERING, not a threshold: the asset base may not be older than the information set the study says it read.

BUILT. engine/ke_reproduction.py + check_ke_reproduction.py + a 14-case negative control, in the gauntlet, and the sanctioned module now emits the field so every future record declares it. NOTHING IN THE BOOK IS A WRONG NUMBER: all seven records reproduce exactly — five under the plain construction and two under a Hamada relevering at 22.50% — and what was outstanding is that no record SAID WHICH, so a relevered beta was indistinguishable from a typo.

The census returned 14 lenses, 42 gap claims adversarially refuted, 40 surviving. Its first finding CORRECTED THIS SESSION: [R-ASSET-01] checks the asset base's VINTAGE and nothing checked that any arithmetic READS it — both developers register, commit and PRINT a land bank no calculation touches. Closed by [R-ASSET-02]. Two more verified and closed: the exemplar's own weights sum to 0.872 and its WACC reproduces from neither reading, and no record named where its beta came from.

queue.item: Bring all 90 names into gate scope
queue.detail: LARGELY ALREADY THERE, and finding that out was the work. check_published_coverage already holds every published ticker against a study or the ratchet, and check_valuation_gap already takes its population from the book. What was missing is now built: check_published_gap reads all 90 gaps from the site itself.

BUILT. scripts/repair_loop.py runs every gate, collects failures as ranked work orders, and ASSERTS its three prohibitions after every run. First run: 64 green, 3 red, 0 broken — and all three reds were its own author's debt.

BUILT and PASSING 5 of 5. Three are the principal's own named errors; two are defects this house has ALREADY SHIPPED ONCE, so the rules adopted on them cannot quietly stop working. Each is planted in a real study that is NOT on that gate's ratchet, the gate is proved green on the unmutated copy first, the mutation asserts it landed, and the gate must go red NAMING the study.

queue.item: Wire the new gates into CI
queue.detail: All four run in study-provenance.yml, before check_tree_unmodified which stays last. A check somebody has to remember to run is run until the day it matters.

queue.item: Triage the debt by what it actually needs
queue.detail: engine/debt_triage.py. A work list says WHAT is outstanding; this says whether anything could close it without a person, which is what decides how much a repair loop is ever worth. 0% unclassified — an unclassified item is an unanswered question, not a clean one.

errors.words: erroneous fair values that are 60% of the current prices in a wrong way
errors.by: check_valuation_gap audits any gap over 10%; check_publish_block holds the study from publishing

errors.words: current landbank of a developer but does not account for new land added
errors.by: check_asset_base — new since today. Binds on every new and rebuilt study; the 11 existing in-scope studies are on the ratchet WITH their measurements, PHDC named with its 21-month-stale land base.

errors.words: creates wrong cost or high Ke and Kd
errors.by: check_ke_reproduction — new since today. Ke must reproduce from rf* + beta x ERP, and the terminal under a construction named from a closed list. A Ke typed 300bp high is case one of its negative control.

schedule_note: Dated from the measured rate rather than a wish: on 07-09-2026 six gates were built, negative-controlled and wired in one session, and the 40 census gaps fall into 15 FAMILIES that share a gate rather than 40 separate ones. Two families a day to the 14th. Every row names the census families it closes, so a slip is visible as a family still open rather than as a date that moved.

schedule.title: Reach, repair, proof
schedule.detail: P1 and P3 closed. Twelve gates: asset-base vintage and wiring, Ke reproduction with weights and beta provenance, lens independence, the reader-side gap, the retired blend on all 93 pages, the relationship between a study's own figures, the per-share gate's free escape, the spread a terminal reinvests at, the profit anchor against the study's own balance sheet, a record surviving its own rebuild, the terminal's maintenance override and its unsourced working capital. [R-ASSET-02] and [R-STD-02] adopted in both governing documents.

schedule.title: Revenue and cost, built or asserted
schedule.detail: Brought forward from the 12th, because the 8th's own two families closed on the 7th. Gross margin held as an input where the filings disclose cost per unit; one blended domestic index on physically distinct cost lines; a globally-traded input escalated on the house domestic ladder; the ground-up build that is still a self-attested boolean; a volume ladder outrunning the plant that produces it.

schedule.title: What the study read, and when
schedule.detail: 'Latest disclosed period' is a field a study types about itself; a P&L anchor older than the same study's balance sheet; the derived-currency check that runs only when fx is present.

schedule.title: The terminal, end to end
schedule.detail: Terminal return never compared with terminal cost of capital — the ARCC defect found by hand and by nothing since; the maintenance_capex override that bypasses disclosed-life sourcing; the unsourced perpetual working-capital charge.

schedule.title: Enterprise to equity
schedule.detail: Per-share currency and peg conversion; an omitted claim class in the bridge lines; the bridge never joined to the published answer; dWC entering free cash flow with the wrong sign.

schedule.title: Macro, currency and what the study read
schedule.detail: Moved here from the 9th. The derived-currency check that runs only when fx is present; an inflation input registered under a key the book does not use; and the half of 'latest disclosed period' that needs a filings index rather than a comparison between two fields the study wrote itself.

schedule.title: Tax, minorities, and the other 66
schedule.detail: Minority deducted at book while the record declares a value share; the forecast tax rate as a free input; the landbank rule enforced on zero uncovered developers.

schedule.title: Close, prove, and hand over
schedule.detail: The class that is a self-declared string with no external referent. Then the whole set: full sweep, the injection catalogue re-run with every named error, the gauntlet on an empty study, the repair loop on planted defects, and the acceptance record written.
